standard_prerequisites.name: The two pullback statements for a closed constructible image and for a quasi-compact open immersion
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 3003-3007)
standard_prerequisites.use: Handles the two inclusions of the factorization.

core_obligations: Preparation: a retrocompact subset of the space has an induced basis of quasi-compact opens, and every constructible subset is retrocompact (proof lines 2988-2991)
Reduction: writing the constructible set as a finite union of differences of retrocompact opens, the traces are constructible in the pieces, so it suffices to treat one piece (proof lines 2992-3001)

Single piece: for a piece which is the intersection of a retrocompact open and the complement of another, the inclusion factors through the open subset, so the two pullback statements apply and give constructibility in the space (proof lines 3002-3007)
proof_roadmap: 任何 retrocompact 子集的诱导拓扑有准紧开基；由 constructible-is-retrocompact，可构造集尤其如此。
把 E 写成有限个 E_i = U_i ∩ V_i^c；因 E_i = E ∩ E_i 在 E 中可构造，F ∩ E_i 在 E_i 中可构造 ⇒ 只需处理单片。
单片情形：E = U ∩ V^c ⊂ U ⊂ X，对该分解用「闭可构造像」与「准紧开浸入」两条拉回命题。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a space with a basis of quasi-compact opens, a subset constructible in a constructible subset is constructible in the space (author lemma at source lines 2979-2985, label lemma-constructible-in-constructible). The proof (source lines 2987-3008) prepares the induced basis, reduces to a single difference of retrocompact opens by taking traces, and handles that case by factoring the inclusion through the retrocompact open and applying the two pullback statements (proof lines 2987-3007). The reduction to the single piece is the substance. H3.
